newTopicsProposed.subject: Mathematics
newTopicsProposed.reason: Records 237-294 of MathBook1 (58 consecutive records, pages 45-53) are entirely permutation and combination counting: arrangements of the letters of a word with repeats, selections under constraints, circular arrangements, numbers formed from digits, and identities in nPr and nCr. None of the 15 canonical Mathematics topics covers counting: MAT_EQTHEORY and MAT_ALGEBRA are equation theory, MATH_GEOM is similar triangles, and the rest are calculus, coordinate geometry, trigonometry or mechanics. Permutations and combinations is a standard HSC Higher Math unit and a recurring admission-test topic, so this is a genuine gap in the canonical list rather than a stray record cluster. The legacy 66-topic list was assembled from a physics-heavy sample, which is the likely reason it was never created.

notes: Records 151-300 of MathBook1 (parsed_items.jsonl lines 1839-1988). Coverage: straight line completing from b10 (151-172), circles (173-236), permutations and combinations (237-294), trigonometry (295-300). Circles are filed under MAT_COORD_CONIC (Conic Sections), the canonical topic. MAT_PERMCOMB is PROPOSED, not assumed - 21 of this batch's skills carry it and will be ingested but invisible until an editorial decision is made in Backend/tree_data/ontology_config.json. Seven straight-line records re-exercise skills minted in b10 and are listed under reusedExistingSkills rather than re-minted. All descriptions are plain text with no backslashes.
